{{Quote|Some of Meeko's thugs have decent prices on their heads, too.|Rozatta informs Jango Fett of Teep's bounty|<ref name="BH" />}}
'''Burbakker Teep''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] with [[Color/Legends|orange]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] from<ref name="Prima" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]].<ref name="Prima" /> By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> they had become a part-time demolitions expert affiliated with [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealers]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and destroyed several important [[Republic Security Force/Legends|Republic Security Force]] facilities. For this, the Republic Security Force issued a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of 1,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for Teep's capture or 500 for their [[Death/Legends|death]]. Eventually, Teep joined the ranks of the criminal [[Meeko Ghintee]]'s thugs on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Outland Transit Station|Outland Station]].<ref name="Prima" /> They wore a gray [[Clothing|jacket]] over a red shirt with tan pants and black [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="BH" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
In 32 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] visited the station in search of Ghintee. Fett encountered Teep in a corridor after being informed by his companion [[Rozatta]] of bounties on the station. Fett captured Teep alive for the full sum of credits.<ref name="BH" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Burbakker Teep first appeared in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', developed by [[LucasArts]]. In the game, Teep is the first optional bounty available to the player that can be captured alive for a higher sum of credits or killed for a lower amount. When capturing the Gran, they can be stealthily approached from behind. However, if Teep spots Fett, they will attempt to flee the vicinity to hide.<ref name="BH" /> This article assumes that Jango Fett captured Teep alive for the full sum of credits.
